boundedMaterial.values: Original shared flower/paper material and linen finish, existing object-UV atlas pipeline; no painted inventory/contact shadows or screen-space substitute
boundedMaterial.acceptance: C35 narrow material gate independently passed; adopted development default, overall target art remains unaccepted

grayForms.scope: Only existing flower crown +linen; same C27 positions/cup supports/vase/books/furniture,201 lights/camera and192 reflection
grayForms.material: One shared plain gray PBR, no albedo/normal/ORM/texture or designed value. Existing shared branch batch temporarily neutralized for comparison, no extra batch; original surface tones remain untouched in control
grayForms.shape: One high main, two lower depth-staggered overlapping cluster surfaces; support-free raised cloth forms and continuous variable-radius corner into two unequal inward main folds
grayForms.limits: Independent normal480px and two-oblique gray gate pending; no authored material work or target acceptance

formValues.shape: Thirty overlapping primary five-lobed corollas plus24 small perimeter flowers; two broad hanging cloth folds, original commodity support and C27 transforms
formValues.values: Object UV warm-lit/cool-shadow form gradients only. No owned-stock/contact shadow painted into fixed textures, no billboard or emissive substitute
formValues.lighting: Unchanged201 scene/exposure/camera and192 reflection; C30 transport OFF
formValues.acceptance: Pending actual normal full frame and two oblique views; not target acceptance

brightMasses.scope: Only existing central decorative flower crown and linen, locked C27 placement and C28/192 reflection; no stock/economy/rig/camera change

flowers.method: Connected compound heads with12–30 closed cupped five-sided blossoms, variable density/negative space, no cards/alpha

linen.method: Three unequal primary gravity folds from actual25mm rounded edge, original planar commodity support and2mm thickness/24 fringe strands

brightMasses.limits: Actual normal-game material/mass gate and original-target acceptance remain open

tableLook.composition: C27 positions, size, stock groups and actual world-space support unchanged

material.petals: Existing closed vertices/indices; softly bent two-sided normals and existing warm-white matte paper batch, no new batch or petals

contact.refresh: Static casters: render once and invalidate on real stock add/remove or target resize; moving-actor sun shadow stays unchanged
contact.light: existing central practical, position/direction/intensity unchanged; no LTC, added light or shadow image
contact.low: existing central light disabled; contact target not rendered

tableLook.limits: Bounded actual-game A/B candidate, not original-target acceptance or physical GPU performance

contactAtlas.uvOrigin: upper-left PNG/glTF; V is1 minus Blender bake V
contactAtlas.scope: Actual fixed central wood/cloth/vessel/books only. No owned stock, actors, door, FX or player save baked. Not GI or target acceptance.

reflection.scope: Only existing central non-stock celadon vessel; existing actual-room reflected baseline plus broad art-directed window bounce, same geometry/camera and original analytic diffuse
reflection.limits: Single-point hybrid original asset, not new traced GI/parallax/measured photometry or target acceptance

contactState.refresh: Static casters: render once and invalidate on real stock add/remove or target resize; moving-actor sun shadow stays unchanged
contactState.light: existing central practical, position/direction/intensity unchanged; no LTC, added light or shadow image
contactState.low: existing central light disabled; contact target not rendered

cutawayLighting.reason: C22 shadow-only ceiling trial rejected after actual131/132/133 views

roomSpecular.diffuse: Original analytic SH retained; no extra diffuse or real-time light
